description: 郵便局及びその他の郵便施設の状況(旧R5・P42 3-3通信(2)郵便局及びその他の郵便施設の状況) [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Tokyo Metropolitan Government Open Data Catalog Site (catalog.data.metro.tokyo.lg.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 狛江市. （資料について） ・日本郵便株式会社狛江郵便局による提供 （注意事項） ・年次について、令和元年は平成31年として表記。 ・コンビニエンスストア内に設置されている数は含まない。 ・「特定局」「集配局」「無集配局」という語は業務上使わなくなりました。. Coverage: 狛江市. The portal files it under the publisher 狛江市. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is クリエイティブ・コモンズ 表示（CC BY）. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-tokyo-portal.
